issue_context.title: pwm: ledc: esp32c6: Sample won't build
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**

After #80404 PWM sample won't build for esp32c6.

**To Reproduce**

```
west build -b esp32c6_devkitc tests/drivers/pwm/pwm_api/ -p
```

**Expected behavior**

Sample builds.

**Impact**

Unable to use LEDC PWM driver on the device.

**Logs and console output**

```
drivers/pwm/CMakeFiles/drivers__pwm.dir/pwm_led_esp32.c.obj -c /D/Embedded/zephyrproject/zephyr/drivers/pwm/pwm_led_esp32.c
/D/Embedded/zephyrproject/zephyr/drivers/pwm/pwm_led_esp32.c: In function 'pwm_led_esp32_calculate_max_resolution':
/D/Embedded/zephyrproject/zephyr/drivers/pwm/pwm_led_esp32.c:129:31: error: 'SCLK_CLK_FREQ' undeclared (first use in this function); did you mean 'CPU_CLK_FREQ'?
  129 |         uint64_t clock_freq = SCLK_CLK_FREQ;
  ```

review_comments: Would you add a blank line in here to split both definitions?
